_comment: Every Gemini model ID this project is allowed to send, and the ones it must never send.
Two separate services, and mixing them up is the failure this file exists to stop:
aistudio ids go to the Gemini API (generativelanguage.googleapis.com) and are
unaffected by the Antigravity CLI migration; antigravity ids are served by the `agy`
binary and the only authority for them is the live output of `agy models`.
This is a snapshot, not a live lookup: asking the real catalogue needs a billed API
key and network, which does not belong in a unit test. When a model ID changes,
verify it first -- GET /v1beta/models for aistudio, `agy models` for antigravity --
then add it here with the date. An ID absent from this file fails the check, so a
guessed or stale value cannot reach a call site unnoticed.
